MORE:
We wish to inform that the Board of Directors at their meeting held today i.e., Friday, 16th October 2026, inter alia approved the following:

1. UFR for the 2nd quarter ended 30.09.2026, along with the Statutory Auditors' Limited Review Report.

2. Appointment of M/s. Walker Chandiok & Co LLP, Chartered Accountants (Firm Registration No. 001076N/N500013), as the Statutory Auditors of the Company for carrying on the Audit for a period of 5 years commencing from FY 2027-28 and to hold the office from the conclusion of 48th AGM to be held in the year 2027 till the conclusion of the 53rd AGM to be held in the year 2032, subject to approval of the shareholders. Details annexed. 

3. Extension of the maturity period of the partly secured loan of ? 40.30 Crores taken from Tata Projects Limited from the existing 20 years (falling due in 2037) to 25 years (which would now be due in 2042), subject to obtaining the requisite approvals, if any inter alia from TPL.  
Details enclosed.

MORE:
Artson Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 16/10/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on Friday, 16th October 2026 to consider and approve, inter alia the Un-audited Financial Results (UFR) for the second quarter ended 30th September 2026.

Further, in terms of the "Tata Code of Conduct for prevention of Insider Trading and Code of Corporate Disclosure Practices" (the Code), please be informed that the Trading Window for dealing in securities of the Company is closed from 23rd September 2026 till 48 hours of the public announcement of the aforesaid UFR. - details enclosed.
